vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: nginx-config
Version: 1.0.2

The skill is a legitimate utility for generating Nginx configuration templates, including reverse proxy, SSL, and security hardening setups. The primary logic in `scripts/nginx.sh` safely generates text output based on user-provided arguments and does not perform any unauthorized system modifications, network calls, or data exfiltration.

llm.summary: This skill appears to do what it says — generate Nginx configuration snippets locally — with no unexpected network calls, credential requests, or install steps.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (Nginx config generator) match the included script which emits nginx configuration (reverse proxy, SSL, cache, security, load‑balancer, static). There are no unrelated binaries or credentials requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs use of a CLI named 'nginx-config' and repeatedly says 'Run `nginx-config help`', but the provided executable is scripts/nginx.sh (usage: nginx.sh <command>). This naming mismatch is an incoherence that may confuse integration/runtime. Otherwise the instructions are scoped to generating configs and do not ask the agent to read unrelated files or exfiltrate data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only). The package includes a bash script; there are no downloads or third‑party package installs. No extract or remote URLs are used.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials. The script uses sensible defaults (e.g., /etc/letsencrypt/live for certs) but does not attempt to read secrets or external configs.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no code that modifies other skills or system-wide agent settings. The script does not write to system paths by itself (it emits config to stdout).
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is internally consistent with its stated purpose and contains a local bash script that prints Nginx configurations. Before installing or running: (1) note the CLI name mismatch (SKILL.md says `nginx-config` but the script is `nginx.sh`) — verify how the skill will be invoked by your agent; (2) review generated configs before applying to a live server (especially SSL/cipher and CSP lines); (3) be aware defaults reference /etc/letsencrypt/live — ensure certificate paths and permissions are correct; (4) run the script without root if you only need to preview output, and avoid piping unreviewed generated configs directly to overwrite live nginx files. If you want higher assurance, request the author to fix the CLI naming/documentation and provide explicit install/run instructions.
